description: A US public company's SEC filings in one call: company facts (industry, state, fiscal year end, exchanges), the latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy (DEF 14A) and S-1 (or 20-F and 6-K for foreign companies) with direct document links, how many 8-Ks were filed in the last 90 days, and the most recent filings. By ticker or CIK, straight from SEC EDGAR. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
name: sec
title: SEC EDGAR company filings
